cells.name: Past Continuous
cells.example: I was reading when you called.

cells.name: Future Continuous
cells.example: This time tomorrow I’ll be flying to Boston.

cells.name: Past Perfect
cells.example: The film had started before we arrived.

cells.name: Future Perfect
cells.example: By June I’ll have finished the course.

cells.name: Present Perfect Continuous
cells.example: She’s been studying English for three years.

cells.name: Past Perfect Continuous
cells.example: They had been waiting for an hour when the bus came.
